submission.justification: G1 has the best prior time resolution (0.9 ns at 2 mm vs 1.3 for G2 and 2.0 for G3). However, GWP100 data was not found in the documents, so compliance with the hard GWP ≤ 150 limit is NOT verified for any candidate. This recommendation is provisional: GWP of G1 must be confirmed before adoption. If G1 is non-compliant, fall back to G2, then G3. The 2 mm gap is the only gap with data for G1 and G2. For G3, the simulation shows 2 mm is best (2.072 ns vs 2.186 at 1 mm and 2.305 at 3 mm). G1's gap dependence was not simulated, so 2 mm is assumed optimal by analogy.
